steps.content: Lynn, take your camera, let's go out.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Why, why suddenly...?
Lynn seems shocked by your sudden visit.
Didn't you say you liked photography? I've applied for a permit to leave. Let's go out for a photoshoot.
Ever since the abrupt end of the last interrogation, you've been wanting to untie that knot in Lynn's heart and compensate her.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Can... can I really?
She sounds hesitant, but the anticipation is brimming in her voice.
Of course, I've had everything sorted out.
Lynn is rather anxious on the way, clutching her camera nervously.
It was not until she set foot on Syndicate's territory that she became tangibly excited.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Not much... has changed here!
She looks like she can't wait to go and take some photos, but hesitates to step out. Instead, she turns to you as if looking for permission.

options: You can go wherever you want.

choices.text: You can go wherever you want.

steps.content: I understand. Photographers are free spirits.
You guys like to wander and look for inspiration, and you're good at spotting unique views others don't notice.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I, I'm no photographer...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I only tend to notice... those unnoticeable corners...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I guess... I just don't see beauty the same way others do! Anyway, anyway...
If they can grab your attention, I'm sure they're really interesting places.
I'm intrigued too, show me.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Um... O-okay...
You follow Lynn and watch how her steps change from hesitant and tentative to light and carefree, like a small animal that's just been uncaged.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Please follow me closely... I usually take the unfrequented alleys. They're quite complex... It's easy to get lost in them...
I'm impressed you can navigate these alleys, it's sure not easy...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Hmm... I have to sacrifice the views along the main road, but I have no other choice...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: After all, I look weird... I don't want others to see me...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Besides, I don't really... take pictures of people.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: My favorite objects are those... that don't speak.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Because they're quiet... They won't mock me or lecture me. They are just... kind to me.
As if remembering something, Lynn touches her camera and whispers to you.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: However... I do have a friend who's willing to be my model...
A friend from here? I bet you haven't seen each other in a long time then.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Hmm...
You don't get to come out every day, why don't we go visit your friend now?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Can... can we?
Of course, I'll let you decide our itinerary today.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Tha... Thank you very much, Chief...!
As you keep walking, Lynn suddenly stops in front of a road sign so old that it's almost unreadable.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: This road sign... means something special to me...
Finding the good lighting and angle, Lynn takes a picture of it seriously.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: It signifies the border of Syndicate. Whenever I reach here, I feel like it's welcoming me...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Everything behind it can become the objects of my photos...
Do you mean... this is the starting point of your photography journey?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I, I suppose you can say that...
Lynn knocks on her helmet a little bashfully, then turns around to lead you into another small alley, snapping photos as she goes.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Look, Chief... You don't see this in Eastside, do you?
Lynn raises her camera and tilts her head back to snap another photo. You lean in, and she shows you the shot she's just taken.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I guess these messy old cables can only be found in Syndicate these days...
Hmm... Somehow, I have a feeling that these cables are growing defiantly in this picture.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: You... you think so too?
Lynn looks up in surprise. Her tone is lifted unconsciously as her fingertip hovers above the viewfinder.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Although many people say they're filthy and messy, I think they look like the veins that connect the city and the sky... Vibrant and full of energy!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: It's the first time... someone has seen through my thought behind the photo...
I can feel it because your photo is expressive enough.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...Thank you! I, I simply let my passion guide me...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Um, you don't need to compliment me or anything... As long as you like my photos, that's more than enough...
But it's because I like your photos, I'm complimenting you.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Eh? But it makes me... kinda embarrassed...
Lynn grips her camera nervously, her body swaying slightly with shyness, like a little bunny that may hop away any moment now.
You deserve my compliments.
The screen on her helmet seems to stutter for a second. She looks even more ready to flee now.
You smile and decide to go easy on the extremely shy Miss Bunny for now.
You suddenly notice you've already walked past several forks. You look up and see an enormous structure with a chaotic and bizarre shape not far ahead.
That's the Drifter Camp... Lynn, what are you looking for?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Ah, I'm looking for...
Woof, woof!
You hear a few barks and Lynn immediately looks around, searching. Suddenly, a big yellow dog scurries toward her.
Watch out!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Yellow!
That big yellow dog paws at her enthusiastically and wags its tail amiably, like it's very used to seeing her.
Could this dog be... that friend?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Yes! Yellow lives in the Drifter Camp, but sometimes he comes out...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: He's a very good boy. Once, some thug tried to snatch my camera and Yellow chased him away...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: It's not an expensive camera, but my parents gifted it to me and it's my most treasured belonging... I'm really grateful to Yellow...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: So whenever I get a chance... I come to give him some treats and play with him...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Oh... I'm glad he still recognizes me after all this time...
Yellow must think of you as an important friend too.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Hehe... Perhaps!
Lynn plays with Yellow for a long while and captures many of his cool and fun moments with her camera.
Before parting, she squats beside Yellow to caress his neck, looking like she misses him already.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Goodbye, Yellow... This may be the last time we see each other...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...Oh? I thought... Can I come again?
Lynn looks up in shock.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I thought this was the last time... I could take photos freely...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I'm grateful for the memories you've brought me today, Chief. You make me feel like a normal person... instead of... a monster.
Lynn, if you want to live a normal life, why don't you try to take off the helmet?
Without the helmet, you can be just like any other girl, not a monster.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: No... No way!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I can't control that power... Without the helmet, I'll... I'll...
Lynn quivers all over and steps back slowly but uncontrollably, as if fearing you may come up to remove her helmet.
You immediately wave your hand to show you mean no harm and comfort her gently.
Listen, Lynn.
I've always told you this: trust me. I have a power named the shackles which can stop your ability.
All those scenarios you dread, I've considered them.
All you have to tell me is this: do you want to take off the helmet?
A few steps away, the girl listens to what you say and falls silent.
After a long while, she answers softly.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I... do.
Then don't hold back, give me all your trust this time.
The girl looks at your hand reaching out to her, hesitates briefly, then takes it, her fingertips warm with wary reliance.
When the crimson light fades, the girl takes off her helmet, but her eyes are still squeezed shut and her brow is tightly wrinkled.
...Lynn, open your eyes.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I, I'm scared...
...Don't be scared. Whatever happens, I'll bear the consequence for you.
Lynn opens her eyes slowly.
Nothing is destroyed. No one is hurt. Nothing horrible has happened. In her eyes, the world simply goes on normally.
So? Without the helmet, doesn't the world look much clearer?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Y-yes...
Lynn stares at the view before her eyes in a daze, tears streaming down her face uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Ah... How... How come my sight is blurry again...
Hey, let's go and check out some other places too.
You take Lynn's hand and lead her out of the alley to the bustling street. As you walk, no one gives you any weird looks.
Now that you don't have to hide anymore, you can go anywhere for your photos.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...Yes!
The girl stands in the middle of the street openly, lifts her camera, and captures every beautiful scene with the ever-snapping shutter.
No one knows why there are both tears and a smile on her face as she takes these photos, just like no one knows how hard she's striven for such a simple and mundane moment... except you.

options: How are you feeling without the helmet?

choices.text: How are you feeling without the helmet?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I feel... so happy. I've never felt so happy before...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: How nice... If I could keep on living like this...
You can.
If you're willing to, I can help you learn how to control your power.
You can totally start over.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: But I've hurt so many people before...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Do I really deserve to... live so openly and uninhibitedly?
...That day, did you hurt them on purpose?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: No... Of course not...!

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: They started it first... I got too scared... So I...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: When I woke up... it was already too late...
And after that?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: After that, I fled... I accidentally fell into the sewers of Eastside, so I just hid there, until... you guys found me.
If you ask me... I think you've already received the punishment you deserved.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: What...?
Before being detained by the Bureau, you hid in the filthy sewers and lived like a homeless.
Ever since coming to the Bureau, not only have you lost your freedom, but you also have to risk your life to solve Mania crises.
Aren't these difficult situations enough retribution for you already?

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Sob...
Moreover, those who were hurt did something wrong too. Their mistake was the cause of this entire tragedy.
Everyone must pay a price for their malicious act.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: But, but I...
You were a victim who exercised imperfect self-defense. That's all.
Although your life will never be the same now... I still hope that you can find the happiness you've found today in the future.
Listening to your words, Lynn is still shedding tears, but she tries her best to squeeze out a small smile.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Thank you, Chief...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: How useless I am... You have to waste your energy to comfort me...
We can't always be trapped in our past. Lynn, as long as you face it with courage, you can defeat it.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Courage...
Something seems to spring to her mind. Lynn picks out two candies from her pocket.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: These are... the candies of courage you and OwO gave me. You said if I ate it, I could gain real courage...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I haven't eaten them this whole time. Perhaps deep down, I knew I hadn't made up my mind yet.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: But... now is the time.
She peels off the wrap slowly and puts the candy in her mouth.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Mm... It's indeed very sweet...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: ...Mmm.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: I promise you, I'll try to accept... the changes this power has brought me...

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: One day, with my own strength, I want to... become that ordinary girl once again...
Congratulations, you're back on your feet now.
Everyone who cares about you must be so glad for you.
A hint of bitterness suddenly flickers in Lynn's smile. You realize there is still another scar in her heart to be smoothed.

steps.speaker: Lynn
steps.content: Yes... Perhaps...
